units.source_text: 我抱着木贼草和燕子花造访柏木的公寓时，他正躺着看书。

en.t: When I visited Kashiwagi's apartment carrying horsetail grass and rabbit-ear irises, he was lying down reading a book.

units.source_text: 我担心会碰上公寓的姑娘，幸好她不在家。

en.t: I was worried that I might run into the girl from the apartment, but fortunately she was not at home.
